verses.text: أَنْقِذْنِي مِنْ أَعْدَائِي يَا إِلهِي. مِنْ مُقَاوِمِيَّ احْمِنِي.

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: نَجِّنِي مِنْ فَاعِلِي الإِثْمِ، وَمِنْ رِجَالِ الدِّمَاءِ خَلِّصْنِي،

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: لأَنَّهُمْ يَكْمِنُونَ لِنَفْسِي. الأَقْوِيَاءُ يَجْتَمِعُونَ عَلَيَّ، لاَ لإِثْمِي وَلاَ لِخَطِيَّتِي يَا رَبُّ.

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: بِلاَ إِثْمٍ مِنِّي يَجْرُونَ وَيُعِدُّونَ أَنْفُسَهُمُ. اسْتَيْقِظْ إِلَى لِقَائِي وَانْظُرْ!

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: وَأَنْتَ يَا رَبُّ إِلهَ الْجُنُودِ، إِلهَ إِسْرَائِيلَ انْتَبِهْ لِتُطَالِبَ كُلَّ الأُمَمِ. كُلَّ غَادِرٍ أَثِيمٍ لاَ تَرْحَمْ. سِلاَهْ.

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: يَعُودُونَ عِنْدَ الْمَسَاءِ، يَهِرُّونَ مِثْلَ الْكَلْبِ، وَيَدُورُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ.

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.text: هُوَذَا يُبِقُّونَ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ. سُيُوفٌ فِي شِفَاهِهِمْ. لأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ: «مَنْ سَامِعٌ؟ ».

excerpts: Prayer for Deliverance. To the chief musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.
